description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Append class, which compiles the {append} template tag used in Smarty templating engine. It extends the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Assign class and overrides the compile method to generate code that appends values to template variables at runtime.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Append
classes.description: A compiler class for processing the {append} tag in Smarty templates, responsible for generating PHP code that appends values to template variables.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to append a value to a template variable, processing attributes such as var, value, scope, and index.
